articles.title: CNN Poll: Americans doubt Trump is paying enough attention to the country’s most important problems - CNN
articles.description: A record-high 73% of US adults say that President Donald Trump hasn’t paid enough attention to the country’s most important problems, a new CNN poll conducted by SSRS finds, with just 27% saying he’s had the right priorities.
